overview_description.description: Shoora Technologies is a Dubai-based AI and IoT startup that provides smart fleet management, video telematics, and logistics solutions for businesses. The company uses technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), cloud computing, and IoT to help companies improve vehicle safety, tracking, delivery efficiency, and overall fleet operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Shoora Technologies is a fleet management and logistics technology company.

product.name: Fleet Management
product.description: A logistics and supply chain decision-making engine designed to reduce costs and improve efficiency, consistency, and transparency in operations.

product.name: Video Telematics
product.description: Utilizes camera-based analytics and safety features to enhance vehicle safety on the road, reduce accidents, and save costs.

product.name: Fuel Management
product.description: Provides tools and technologies to optimize and monitor fuel usage, aiming to enhance fleet performance and reduce costs.

product.name: Control Room Service
product.description: A centralized hub equipped with monitoring and management tools for real-time data analysis and incident response.
